LanguageData.IRBM_HeisenbergUncertaintyTrait.degreeDa: Reina was born with an extreme "uncertainty." This is an exceptionally rare benign genetic trait of the Heisenberg family, traceable back to the 15th century. Family legends say their ancestor was an alchemist who could miraculously escape any danger. This miracle has been passed down all the way to her.\n\nIn the eyes of others, she is like a probability cloud in a state of superposition, difficult to observe precisely.
